_comment: Condiciones de reserva. Fuente única para book.php (renderiza HTML) y el bot de WhatsApp (envía texto).

sections.title: Hours
items: Free luggage storage: 7:30 AM to 8:00 PM

sections.title: Breakfast
items: Included in our café: coffee/tea, toast with jam, and fruit.

sections.title: Rates
items: Foreign guests: Listed rates are tax-exempt for guests who present a valid passport and immigration entry stamp at check-in.
Argentine nationals: Argentine citizens are subject to 21% VAT, added to the listed rates.
Payment methods: Cash in Argentine pesos, or credit/debit card with a 10% surcharge.

sections.title: General Conditions
items: Bookings longer than 7 days are subject to review. We only accept bookings from guests who do not reside in the Greater Mendoza area.
Cancellations within the stated deadlines incur no penalty.

sections.title: Guest Conduct
items: We expect all guests to respect the hostel's rules, staff, and fellow guests. Any violation may result in expulsion without a refund.

sections.title: No-Shows & Cancellations
items: Flexible Booking: Cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancelling within 48 hours of check-in incurs a charge for the first night; no-shows or last-minute cancellations are charged the full reservation amount.
Non-refundable Booking: The full stay is charged at the time of cancellation, or in the event of a no-show on the check-in date.
